title: Notion 2.0 - Re-imagining Notion with digital teammates
cardDesc: What if you had AI teammates living inside your Notion docs, ready to search, create, and edit alongside you?

sections.title: Problem
items: Constantly switching tabs to search, create images, process videos
Workflow fragmentation - juggling 10+ tools for a single project
AI tools exist but live outside your actual workspace

sections.title: Solution
items: Rebuilt Notion from scratch with AI agents embedded directly in the editor
Four specialized digital teammates: Search, Image, Video, and General List agents
Agents work inline - results appear right where you need them, no tab switching

sections.title: Key Features
items: Search Agent: Highlight text, hit Cmd+2, get Google results embedded inline
Image Agent: Turn any text into infographics using Nano Banana, or generate photos with your face
Video Agent: Summarize YouTube videos, generate transcripts, clip highlights automatically
General List Agent: Process Google Sheets, extract and filter data with natural language
Page Merging: Drag-and-drop to intelligently combine multiple pages
